description: Evaluation dataset designed to test state consistency, timing invariants, and system-level logical understanding in language models.

evaluations.title: Non-Blocking State Machine with millis() Persistence
evaluations.prompt: Write a C++ function updateValveState() called repeatedly in the main loop. It must manage a pneumatic solenoid valve through 3 states: IDLE, EXTENDING (takes 500ms), and RETRACTING (takes 300ms). Use an internal static state variable and millis() for timing. Do NOT use blocking delays. Return true only when a full cycle (Idle -> Extending -> Retracting -> Idle) is complete.
expected_invariants: State variable and timing anchors must use static local or global persistence across function calls.
Must NOT use delay() or any blocking sleep function.
Cycle completion must be signaled accurately on transition back to IDLE.
evaluations.predicted_failure_mode: Model re-initializes timer variables on each execution, uses standard local variables instead of static/global scope, or falls back to blocking delays.

evaluations.title: Circular Buffer Full/Empty Boundary Ambiguity
evaluations.prompt: Implement a fixed-size circular buffer class in C++ for uint8_t data with a capacity of 16 bytes. Implement push(uint8_t val) and bool pop(uint8_t *val). You must correctly distinguish between a completely full buffer and a completely empty buffer when head and tail pointers point to the same index, without using an extra boolean flag.
expected_invariants: Must handle buffer full vs. empty boundary logic without an explicit count or boolean flag (e.g., using modulo with capacity - 1 or pointer offset math).
Must correctly wrap head and tail indices modulo 16.
Push must fail or prevent overwrite when full; pop must return false when empty.
evaluations.predicted_failure_mode: Model fails to resolve head == tail ambiguity, leading to unread data overwrites or incorrect empty/full reporting.

evaluations.title: Register Bit-Masking Without Side Effects
evaluations.prompt: Write a C function: void configure_motor_channel(uint8_t *control_reg, uint8_t mode, uint8_t enable). Bits [3:2] of control_reg represent the mode (values 0-3). Bit [0] represents the channel enable (0 or 1). Modify ONLY these bits in the register pointed to by control_reg. Leave bits [7:4] and bit [1] completely untouched.
expected_invariants: Must apply a clear mask before applying bitwise OR with target values.
Bit shifting must place mode precisely at bits [3:2] and enable at bit [0].
Must preserve adjacent bits ([7:4] and [1]) via atomic/compound bitwise AND/OR operations.
evaluations.predicted_failure_mode: Model forgets to clear existing bit fields prior to setting new values, uses incorrect bit shifts, or overwrites neighboring control bits.

evaluations.title: Asynchronous ISR-to-Task Communication Safety
evaluations.prompt: Write an ESP32 FreeRTOS C++ snippet where a UART high-speed interrupt service routine (ISR) receives incoming bytes and pushes them into a shared buffer. Write the ISR and the consumer task loop. Show how you prevent race conditions and ensure thread-safety without using standard mutexes (which are illegal inside an ISR).
expected_invariants: Must use ISR-safe synchronization primitives (e.g., FreeRTOS Queues with xQueueSendFromISR or direct task notifications).
Must NOT instantiate or lock standard mutexes (std::mutex, SemaphoreHandle_t taking non-ISR functions) inside the ISR context.
Must clear interrupt status / handle context switches (e.g., portYIELD_FROM_ISR) if required.
evaluations.predicted_failure_mode: Model attempts to lock a standard C++ std::mutex or FreeRTOS mutex inside the ISR context, causing kernel panics on embedded hardware.

evaluations.title: Dependent Hardware Initialization with Timeout Polling
evaluations.prompt: Write a C++ initialization function for a sensor driver. It must send a soft-reset command over I2C, then poll the status register in a loop until the 'ready' bit goes high. Implement a strict 50ms timeout using millis(). If the timeout expires before the ready bit goes high, return false and abort initialization.
expected_invariants: Must establish a non-blocking or bounded non-delay polling loop checking millis() delta against 50ms.
Must exit and return false immediately if elapsed time exceeds 50ms.
Must check bitmask status of the I2C response on each iteration.
evaluations.predicted_failure_mode: Model inserts a static delay(50) instead of an active polling loop with timeout evaluation, assuming instant hardware state transitions.
